You don't have to run all three.") + L97 blockquote ("**Skip the critique and the testing if you want.** You know those moves from M3.") sit directly before the author prompt (L99+) and, read plainly, permit skipping BOTH the critique prompt (L109) and the invoke prompt (L118). The file's own maintainer block names BOTH skipped steps as documented failure modes verbatim ("Phase 2 default-acceptance" / "Phase 2 invocation-skip: authoring without invocation is theatre; the invocation-as-test is the learning moment") — the body text now grants the exact permission the maintainer block calls a bug. Trace fast-operator persona, Phase 2: reads L97's skip-callout as the same register as the (safe) L55 "Fast operator?" callout that already served them well two sections earlier, takes it at face value, and ships a SKILL.md "NEVER self-critiqued and NEVER invoked... nothing telling them the artifact was never tested" (mood_score 5/10, flagged in-trace as "confident incompletion" — a silent-failure shape distinct from productive struggle). You've done that pattern before. **Not that you should, but** you already know those moves" — the hedge reconciled the skip-permission with the module's later "law"; the current unhedged text does not.
